source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 29 measured values (29 from the ThermoML Archive), 330.20-455.61 K, max deviation 6.8 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Chernyak 2004 +0.13 %; Verevkin 2008 -0.00 %.
